Hello! It’s great to connect with you. I’m Ibrahim Abdulazeez — you can call me Ib. I’m currently based in Lagos, Nigeria, and I’m a Senior Software Engineer with over 8 years of experience building scalable, AI-driven products.

I spend most of my time these days architecting and delivering AI-powered solutions — from LLM applications and agent workflows to full-stack development with React, Node, and Python. Recently, I’ve been focused on deploying AI features into production environments, optimizing for leverage through automation, and building systems that solve real business problems, especially across Africa.

How can I help you today? Are you looking to discuss a technical challenge, explore potential collaborations, or just learn more about my experience? I’m happy to dive into any of those!
